section_summary.extract_value: This section details a Latent Profile Analysis (LPA) performed on two distinct samples, a Polish sample and MTurk samples, to investigate the nature of creativity (latent profiles vs. factors) using the K-DOCS. The analysis involved evaluating various profile models based on fit indices like bootstrapped LRT and BIC. Ultimately, a four-profile model was selected as the best-fitting and most consistent solution across both samples, suggesting quantitative rather than qualitative differences in creativity profiles.
